senses.gloss: f. (בדד, v. בַּד II) small olive press. Sifra B’har ch. I one may grind the olives in the large tank ומכניס לבד׳ and then put them into the small press; Shebi. VIII, 6 לבוד׳.—Pl. בְּדִידוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="B00110"><he>בדדיות</he></cite>, <he>בדריות</he>, corr. acc.).
